stem:
Veena's school fees are ₹800. A late fee is charged at 5% of the fees.

What must she decide before calculating the late-fee amount?

options.text: Only the multiplier 5/100, without naming any whole in rupees.
That 5% gives the same rupee amount on every bill, so the whole does not matter.
That the whole is ₹800, so the late fee is (5/100) × 800.
Start from a guessed late-fee amount and reverse to invent both the fees and the percent.

teacher.key_rationale: y% of a value is (y/100) times that value; the base supplies the whole. Here the whole is ₹800. Ignoring the base, treating every whole as the same, or reversing from an amount all skip choosing the whole first.
